name: Soul of the Cleric
body:
Associated Skills: Diplomacy, Heal, Knowledge (religion), Knowledge (planes)

Associated Veils: Angelic Wings, Criniere of Warding, Demon Lord’s Hunger, Gilded Treads, Iron Crown, Pit Fiend’s Shroud, Shackles of Perdition, Vanth’s Eyes

Channel Energy (Su)

At 1st level, tapping into the soul of the cleric has allowed you to channel the powers of the outer planes. When you forge this soul, choose positive or negative energy. You can channel that energy type as the cleric’s channel energy class feature a number of times each day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier, and use your Wisdom to determine its saving throws. Temporary increases to your Wisdom do not increase the number of times you may use this ability each day.

Languages of the Outer Planes (Su)

At 1st level, the soul of the cleric imbues you with greater understanding of the outer realms, allowing you to understand Celestial, Abyssal, and Infernal.

You can read and understand the spoken languages, but you cannot write or speak them.

Domain

At 3rd level, the soul of the cleric grants you powers related to a single religious domain. Each time you forge this soul, select a domain available to the cleric: you gain the abilities of that domain granted to a cleric at 1st level. At 11th level, you gain the 8th level ability as well. Use your soulforge level as your cleric level and when determining the effects of those abilities. You do not gain access to the domain’s domain spells.
